Name: BUDDY_PARAM_ST
Description: Spirit Ash summons. A spirit ash item (EquipParamGoods) applies a SpEffect; its ID rounded down to a multiple of 100 picks the rows (Trigger SpEffect ID), and the last two digits are the upgrade level (e.g. 200005 is Black Knife Tiche +5). Every row with that Trigger SpEffect ID spawns one character, so a group summon uses one row per member.

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game.
Padding.
Padding.

Fields.Name: Trigger SpEffect ID
Fields.Description: Summon key: the spirit ash item's SpEffect ID with the last two digits dropped (multiples of 100, e.g. 200000 for 200000–200010). All rows with the same value are summoned together.

Fields.Name: NPC Param ID
Fields.Description: NpcParam of the summoned character. -1: this row spawns nothing.

Fields.Name: NPC Think Param ID
Fields.Description: NpcThinkParam (AI) of the summoned character.

Fields.Name: NPC Param ID - Mount
Fields.Description: NpcParam of a mount for the summoned character; when set, this NpcParam is also used for the spawn clearance. -1: none. Retail -1 on every row.

Fields.Name: NPC Think Param ID - Mount
Fields.Description: NpcThinkParam of the mount set in NPC Param ID - Mount. -1: none. Retail -1 on every row.

Fields.Name: Spawn Offset: X (left/right)
Fields.Description: Sideways offset (m) of the spawn point from the summon point, in the summoner's facing frame; the final point is then placed on nearby ground.

Fields.Name: Spawn Offset: Z (forward/back)
Fields.Description: Forward/back offset (m) of the spawn point from the summon point, in the summoner's facing frame.

Fields.Name: Spawn Angle: Y
Fields.Description: Facing of the summoned character relative to the summoner's facing (degrees).

Fields.Name: Appear around Summoning Stone
Fields.Description: If any row of the summon has this set, the group appears around the area's summoning stone instead of beside the player. Ignored in the Colosseum. Retail: Putrid Corpse, Giant Rat and similar ashes.

Fields.Name: Disable Player Target Share
Fields.Description: Leaves the summon out of target sharing with the player. Retail: Putrid Corpse, Giant Rat, Marionette Soldier and similar ashes.

Fields.Name: Player Follow Type
Fields.Description: Follow behaviour read by the summon's AI script. Retail: 0 most ashes; 1 the ashes that appear around the stone (Putrid Corpse, Giant Rat, Marionette Soldier); 2 Latenna and the Mimic Tear.
